slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: The Data Landscapers essay's Libya clinic row states that rural primary clinics record patient data on paper and that it found no evidence of electronic medical records or digital patient registration at the point of service in rural facilities; it gives no date for this, so the document's publication date is used.

The essay reports a 2016 readiness study (University of Brighton thesis) of five rural clinics that found no e-health technologies in use and IT equipment not used for clinical purposes, rating maturity at level zero: 0 of 5 clinics sampled.

The essay states that DHIS2 was adopted nationally in 2018 for monitoring and evaluation, piloted in a limited number of primary health care centres (it gives six sites as an example) and rolled out for aggregate reporting and surveillance, citing WHO EMRO; no denominator is given.

systems.tiers: adopted nationally 2018; piloted in limited primary health care centres (e.g. 6 sites); aggregate reporting and surveillance
